PsiQuantum

Omega chipset (Moreton Bay / Chicago systems unnamed)

PsiQuantum · photonics · DEMONSTRATED (component level) (Feb 2025) · qubits not published · access: lab-only, no cloud, no external users
architecture: פוטוניקה מבוססת-היתוך (FBQC) · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: single photon, dual-rail (path) encoded, telecom C-band 1550 nm
gate mechanism: linear-optical fusion (probabilistic Bell measurement, 50% / 75% boosted); no gates in the circuit-model sense
connectivity: set by the fusion network (any 3-D cell complex with 4 faces per edge is a valid surface-code fusion complex); physical routing by BTO switches
control: electro-optic BTO Mach-Zehnder modulators, EO coefficient ~1000 pm/V; feed-forward within one clock cycle
control placement: room-temp electro-optic
readout: waveguide-integrated SNSPD, destructive, photon-number-resolving; 93.4% median on-chip efficiency (the 98.9% figure is superseded)
codes: fusion, rbh
flags: a component, not a machine, cryogenic details missing, no qec cycle

Technologies by layer — the machine's cell per layer

1 נושא הקיוביט
פוטון בודד (משתנה בדיד) · primary ▣ Fig. 2a,b (photon source, 99.5% purity); §Photon sources ✅
single photon, dual-rail (path) encoded, telecom C-band 1550 nm; Omega chipset demonstrated at component level Feb 2025
2 קידוד
קידוד מסילה כפולה (מחיקה) · primary ▣ Fig. 3a,e (qubit SPAM circuit, Pauli eigenstates) ✅
dual-rail path encoding; loss handled as erasure (model threshold 11.98% erasure / 1.07% Pauli per fusion)
קידוד פוטוני בתאי זמן / במסלולים · alternate ◌ 🔎
alternate photonic dual-rail family; PsiQuantum states path encoding
3 מנגנון השער
היתוך באופטיקה ליניארית (מבושר) · primary ▣ Fig. 3d,h (two-qubit fusion); Fig. 3c,f (HOM) ✅
linear-optical fusion (probabilistic Bell measurement, 50%/75% boosted); 2-qubit fusion fidelity 99.22 ± 0.12%, HOM visibility 99.5% (Feb 2025)
מפעל מצבי משאב רב-פוטוניים (טבעת-6 וכו') · alternate ▨ 🔎
missing half: no resource-state factory result published; source purity ~99.8%
4 קישוריות והובלה
מיתוג / ניתוב פוטוני (אלקטרו-אופטי, הזנה קדימה) · primary ▣ Fig. 2d (MZI >50 dB extinction); Fig. 5g (BTO MZI) ✅
set by the fusion network (3-D cell complex, 4 faces per edge); BTO-switch routing; on-chip interferometer fidelity up to 99.999%, >50 dB extinction
5 בקרה
הנעה אלקטרו-אופטית + אלקטרוניקת הזנה קדימה (טמפרטורת החדר) · primary ▣ Fig. 5d–g (BTO Pockels, phase shifter); §Electro-optic switching ✅
BTO Mach-Zehnder modulators, EO coefficient ~1000 pm/V, switch loss ~10 dB/m; feed-forward within one clock cycle; room-temperature electronics
6 קריאה
גילוי פוטון בודד (SNSPD / TES) · primary ▣ Fig. 2e (SNSPD efficiency); Fig. 4d–f (PNRD) ✅
waveguide-integrated PNR SNSPD, destructive; 93.4% median on-chip efficiency (0.30 dB/detection); SPAM fidelity 99.98 ± 0.01% (Feb 2025)
7 קוד
עמידות לתקלות מבוססת-היתוך · primary ▦ ✅
FBQC fusion code on RBH foliated cluster; model thresholds 11.98% erasure / 1.07% Pauli per fusion; no QEC cycle or logical qubit published
8 מפענח
MWPM / Sparse Blossom (+התאמה מתואמת) · primary ▦ ✅
MWPM / union-find on the fusion syndrome graph; offline
9 חיבור בין-מודולי
קישורי סיב בין מודולים פוטוניים · primary ▣ Fig. 3b,g (chip-to-chip qubit interconnect); Fig. 5c (fibre-to-chip) ✅
standard telecom fibre, no transduction; chip-to-chip Bell fidelity 99.72(4)% over up to 250 m; edge coupler ~52(12) mdB/facet
10 ייצור
בית יציקה למעגלים פוטוניים משולבים (SiN, BTO, TFLN, SNSPD על 300 mm) · primary ▣ Fig. 1a–j (process modules, 300-mm wafer, cross-sections); §Technology stack ✅
GlobalFoundries Fab 8 (Malta NY), 300 mm Si photonics, 45 nm node; BTO by custom 300 mm MBE; SiN loss 0.5 vs 1.8(2) dB/m unreconciled
